title: ListingChange
description: Wire contract for a listing-catalog change. Discriminated union of 4 kinds, keyed on `kind`. The core mirrors the engine's src/recs/schemas/listings.py; the fields under the MODSEARCH EXTENSIONS comment (source, listing_url, external_id, condition_tier, color, checked_at, measurements) are ModSearch additions beyond the engine's parity baseline, needed for universal cross-marketplace search and the measurement/color/condition filters. The forked engine must add matching optional fields when these are wired.

measurements.description: Normalized garment measurements. All numeric fields optional; whichever the listing provides or we can extract. Powers the measurement filter (the key differentiator). unit says how to read the numbers.

source_field.description: Where the numbers came from, so the UI can flag lower-confidence (parsed/ocr) measurements.

listing_payload.description: Catalog metadata. Core fields mirror ListingPayload in the engine.

size.description: The labeled size (S/M/L, 32, EU 40). Unreliable across brands/eras; measurements are the real filter.

condition.description: Free-text condition as the source stated it.

source.description: MODSEARCH EXTENSION. Marketplace/boutique id: ebay, shopify:<store>, grailed, agora, ...

listing_url.description: MODSEARCH EXTENSION. Canonical URL to the item.

external_id.description: MODSEARCH EXTENSION. The source's own id for the item.

currency.description: MODSEARCH EXTENSION. ISO-4217 code for `price` (default USD).

color.description: MODSEARCH EXTENSION. Primary color, normalized for the color filter.

condition_tier.description: MODSEARCH EXTENSION. Normalized condition scale for cross-marketplace comparison.

checked_at.description: MODSEARCH EXTENSION. When availability/price was last verified. Drives staleness handling; secondhand items are quantity-one and vanish fast.
